headline: Sensex and Nifty rally as foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices boost market sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Continued foreign fund inflows (FII) into the Indian equity markets
Significant decline in global crude oil prices
Strong buying interest in heavyweight FMCG and telecom stocks
Positive cues from global markets including Asian and US indices
whatHappening: Sensex jumped over 700 points in early trade before stabilizing at a 400-point gain
Nifty 50 successfully breached and traded above the 25,250 level
Realty and Metal indices are underperforming, dropping by approximately 1%
NSE's market capitalization reached a new milestone of ₹5 trillion
summary: Indian markets opened higher on Monday, with the Sensex rising over 400 points and Nifty crossing the 25,250 mark. The rally is primarily driven by sustained foreign institutional investor inflows and a decline in global crude oil prices. FMCG and telecom sectors are leading the gains, while metal and realty stocks face selling pressure.
